measured: Bytes of the tools/list response line from a server with no engine attached, for a client that declared no capabilities.

raises.why: Q5 part 2 (#776): a fields argument on didi_control_room and script_reflect_class, so a caller can ask for one section of the two largest reads instead of all of them, and truncated, omitted_fields and import_error declared in the output schemas of the reads that return them. Measured 204,333 full and 95,617 core with that change; core stays under half of the 203,634 Q4 measured.

Q7 part 1 (#1133): scene_set_property takes writes and scene_get_property takes reads, each a closed, typed item schema, and property_name names a path into a resource the node holds. Both tools are in core, so the same 962 bytes land in both profiles. Measured 205,471 full and 96,616 core with that change; core stays under half of the 203,634 Q4 measured.

Q9 part 1 (#1206): runtime_run_scenario, which proves a behaviour in one call, with its step vocabulary as one closed item schema (kind, frames, action, expression, context_node, minimum, maximum, text, level, absent, label) and a request_id because it runs as a job. It is not in core, so core does not move. Measured 208,435 full with that change, against 205,666 on main: 2,768 bytes, all of it the new entry.

Q9 part 2 (#1206): project_run_tests, which runs the project's GUT or GdUnit4 tests and judges the JUnit report, with framework, paths, name, timeout_seconds and a request_id because it runs as a job. It is not in core, so core does not move. Measured 209,837 full with that change, against 208,435 on main: 1,402 bytes, the new entry and its separator.
